title: Šiviljstvo Mlakar, papirnati kroj
gapNote: The pattern pieces (a trouser front, a pocket, a waistband) are a hand-written decor svg at the 12-path limit: ornament/dashed-cut-line (stance signature) doesn't exist and a path has no dash style, so every cutting line is a row of short segments, and the seam allowance can only follow the straight edges (a dashed curve would need a segment per dash). The pieces can't lie across the whole sheet under the words (a decor element sits in its own cells; as a background drawing layer it would have to be quiet, ink within 1.6:1 of the ground, too faint for the lines to read). No labels on the pieces (cut 2, the piece name), because a decor svg can't hold text and text elements can't be placed onto the drawing at a point. The pale blue-grey sheet is the alt tone on the hero and the visit section; pregib requires a white page, so the price list in between is white. mask/cut needs a photo, and there are none.
sources: L Ogledalo (short service verbs as the headline)
